SELECT rc.loan_id, rc.as_of_date
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
ORDER BY rc.loan_id;

SELECT loan_id, disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown
WHERE status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
ORDER BY loan_id;

SELECT payment_id, business_date, amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE is_cash = 1
  AND amount > 5000000
ORDER BY amount DESC, payment_id;

SELECT p.party_id, pp.annual_income
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY pp.annual_income DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT card_id, issued_on, expires_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'CREDIT'
ORDER BY issued_on, card_id;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, op.operating_status
FROM party p
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
  AND op.registered_region = (
      SELECT ou.region_code
      FROM organization_unit ou
      WHERE ou.unit_name = '上海分行'
  )
ORDER BY p.party_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN account a ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY account_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT s.sector_name_zh, ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN industry_sector s ON s.sector_code = ca.target_industry_code
GROUP BY s.sector_code, s.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, s.sector_name_zh;

SELECT wp.product_name, ROUND(SUM(phs.fair_value), 2) AS total_fair_value
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY total_fair_value DESC, wp.product_name
LIMIT 10;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name, COUNT(*) AS relation_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = p.home_org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY relation_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       cs.net_capital,
       cs.risk_weighted_assets
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
ORDER BY cs.net_capital DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name, ROUND(SUM(abs.ledger_balance), 2) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM account_balance_snapshot abs
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'DEPOSIT'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_deposit_balance DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       AVG(d.principal_overdue_days) AS avg_overdue_days
FROM delinquency_snapshot d
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = d.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE d.principal_overdue_days > 0
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING AVG(d.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY avg_overdue_days DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH member_loan AS (
    SELECT egm.exposure_group_id,
           SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS exposure_amount
    FROM exposure_group_member egm
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
        SELECT ca.agreement_id FROM credit_agreement ca WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    )
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    GROUP BY egm.exposure_group_id
),
group_capital AS (
    SELECT eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id,
           cs.net_capital
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
)
SELECT gc.exposure_group_id,
       gc.group_name,
       ROUND(ml.exposure_amount, 2) AS exposure_amount,
       ROUND(ml.exposure_amount * 1.0 / gc.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_to_capital_ratio
FROM member_loan ml
JOIN group_capital gc ON gc.exposure_group_id = ml.exposure_group_id
ORDER BY exposure_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ins.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN ld.loan_id END) AS npl_count,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN ld.loan_id END) * 1.0
        / COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id), 6
    ) AS npl_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ins ON ins.sector_code = op.industry_code
LEFT JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
LEFT JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
GROUP BY ins.sector_code, ins.sector_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY npl_ratio DESC, ins.sector_code;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, p.party_id
LIMIT 15;

SELECT risk_level,
       COUNT(*) AS product_count,
       ROUND(AVG(management_fee_rate), 4) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM wealth_product
GROUP BY risk_level
ORDER BY risk_level;

SELECT gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
       p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
       ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.status = '有效'
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id;

SELECT p.party_id AS customer_id,
       p.display_name AS customer_name,
       ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, customer_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS record_count,
       ROUND(SUM(d.observed_value), 2) AS total_observed_value
FROM data_security_event_v3 d
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = d.institution_id
WHERE d.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_observed_value DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
WHERE r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY overdue_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.risk_weighted_assets IS NOT NULL AND cs.risk_weighted_assets <> 0
ORDER BY capital_adequacy_ratio ASC, i.institution_name;

SELECT ds.loan_id, ds.principal_overdue_days, cg.grade_name_zh, rc.as_of_date
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND cg.grade_name_zh IN ('正常', '关注')
  AND rc.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(rc2.as_of_date)
      FROM risk_classification rc2
      WHERE rc2.loan_id = ds.loan_id
  )
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC, ds.loan_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS underprovisioned_balance
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
WHERE ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000
ORDER BY underprovisioned_balance DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT pi.instruction_id, pi.loan_id, p.display_name AS payee_name,
       s.sector_name_zh, pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector s ON s.sector_code = op.industry_code
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is2.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS restricted_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 2) AS total_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is2.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 6) AS ratio
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector is2 ON is2.sector_code = op.industry_code
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC, i.institution_id;

SELECT wp.product_id, wp.product_name, ma.asset_id, ma.maturity_on, wp.actual_termination_on
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE wp.actual_termination_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS borrower_agreement_count
FROM party p
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY guarantee_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT pe.payment_id,
       pe.business_date,
       ptc.name_zh AS payment_type_name,
       pe.amount,
       ou.unit_name
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON ptc.payment_type = pe.payment_type
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = pe.origin_org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id;

SELECT ca.agreement_id,
       p.display_name AS borrower_name,
       ind_borrower.sector_name_zh AS borrower_industry_name,
       ind_target.sector_name_zh AS target_industry_name,
       ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind_borrower ON ind_borrower.sector_code = op.industry_code
JOIN industry_sector ind_target ON ind_target.sector_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code <> op.industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT pe.payment_id, pe.business_date, pe.amount,
       fh.party_id AS from_party_id, th.party_id AS to_party_id
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account_holder fh ON fh.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN account_holder th ON th.account_id = pe.to_account_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = fh.party_id
                      AND pr.target_party_id = th.party_id
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, p.display_name AS borrower_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
       ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event p
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = p.from_account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE p.is_cash = 1
  AND p.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT sm.staff_id, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN service_operator so ON so.operator_id = pe.operator_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = pe.to_account_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON isec.sector_code = op.industry_code
WHERE isec.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类')
GROUP BY sm.staff_id
ORDER BY txn_count DESC, sm.staff_id
LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.record_id, i.institution_name, c.event_date, c.deadline_date,
       CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(c.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_diff
FROM customer_due_diligence_event_v3 c
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = c.institution_id
WHERE c.completion_date IS NULL
ORDER BY days_diff DESC, c.record_id
LIMIT 20;

SELECT sa.security_id, ca.collateral_id, ca.status, sa.status
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE ca.status = 'RELEASED'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.security_id;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ca.agreement_id, sa.security_id, so.covered_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY so.covered_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

WITH latest_balance AS (
    SELECT lbs.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lbs.loan_id ORDER BY lbs.as_of_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
),
loan_inst AS (
    SELECT ld.loan_id, ca.institution_id
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT i.institution_name, lb.loan_id, lb.principal_balance,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY li.institution_id ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC, lb.loan_id ASC) AS rnk
    FROM latest_balance lb
    JOIN loan_inst li ON li.loan_id = lb.loan_id
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = li.institution_id
    WHERE lb.rn = 1
)
SELECT institution_name, loan_id, principal_balance, rnk
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH latest_balance AS (
    SELECT lbs.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lbs.loan_id ORDER BY lbs.as_of_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
),
loan_industry AS (
    SELECT ld.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance, isec.sector_name_zh
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN industry_sector isec ON isec.sector_code = ca.target_industry_code
    JOIN latest_balance lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND lbs.rn = 1
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT sector_name_zh, loan_id, principal_balance,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sector_name_zh ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS rnk
    FROM loan_industry
)
SELECT sector_name_zh, loan_id, principal_balance, rnk
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY sector_name_zh ASC, rnk ASC;

SELECT business_date,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
       COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS change_from_prev_day
FROM payment_event
GROUP BY business_date
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       lbs.loan_id,
       lbs.principal_balance,
       ROUND(avg_bal.avg_principal, 2) AS institution_avg_balance,
       ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - avg_bal.avg_principal, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca2.institution_id, AVG(lbs2.principal_balance) AS avg_principal
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON ld2.loan_id = lbs2.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON ca2.agreement_id = ld2.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca2.institution_id
) avg_bal ON avg_bal.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > avg_bal.avg_principal
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC, lbs.loan_id;

SELECT sa.security_id,
       sa.secured_amount,
       COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM collateral_link cl WHERE cl.security_id = sa.security_id
)
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC, sa.security_id;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN '0'
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30'
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '31-90'
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN '91-180'
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN '181-360'
        ELSE '360+'
    END AS overdue_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot d
GROUP BY overdue_bucket
ORDER BY
    CASE overdue_bucket
        WHEN '0' THEN 0
        WHEN '1-30' THEN 1
        WHEN '31-90' THEN 31
        WHEN '91-180' THEN 91
        WHEN '181-360' THEN 181
        ELSE 361
    END;

SELECT collateral_id, valued_on, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM collateral_valuation
GROUP BY collateral_id, valued_on
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY collateral_id;

WITH loan_agg AS (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
           SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal,
           AVG(lbs.principal_balance) AS avg_principal
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT p.display_name AS customer_name,
       la.loan_count,
       ROUND(la.total_principal, 2) AS total_principal,
       ROUND(la.avg_principal, 2) AS avg_principal
FROM loan_agg la
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = la.party_id
ORDER BY la.avg_principal DESC, p.display_name
LIMIT 5;

SELECT ou.unit_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count,
       COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS payment_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN service_operator so ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY payment_count DESC, ou.unit_name
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pp.annual_income), 2) AS avg_annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS high_income_ratio
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY p.customer_segment ASC;

WITH payment_inst AS (
    SELECT pe.payment_id,
           pe.amount,
           COALESCE(fa.institution_id, ta.institution_id) AS institution_id,
           fh.party_id AS from_holder,
           th.party_id AS to_holder
    FROM payment_event pe
    LEFT JOIN account fa ON fa.account_id = pe.from_account_id
    LEFT JOIN account ta ON ta.account_id = pe.to_account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_holder fh ON fh.account_id = pe.from_account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_holder th ON th.account_id = pe.to_account_id
    WHERE fh.effective_to IS NULL
      AND th.effective_to IS NULL
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pr.relation_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS related_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pr.relation_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(p.amount), 2) AS ratio_pct
FROM payment_inst p
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = p.institution_id
LEFT JOIN party_relation pr
       ON pr.source_party_id = p.from_holder
      AND pr.target_party_id = p.to_holder
      AND pr.relation_type <> '非关联方'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio_pct DESC;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS credit_card_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS term_deposit_count
FROM party p
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = ah.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY term_deposit_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       AVG(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on)) AS avg_age_days
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY avg_age_days DESC, i.institution_id;

WITH latest_balance AS (
    SELECT lb.loan_id, lb.principal_balance,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lb.loan_id ORDER BY lb.as_of_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT loan_id, principal_balance,
           NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC) AS quartile
    FROM latest_balance
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT loan_id, principal_balance, quartile
FROM ranked
ORDER BY quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH industry_balance AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(ins.sector_name_zh, '未分类') AS industry_name,
           SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
    LEFT JOIN industry_sector ins ON ins.sector_code = op.industry_code
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
    GROUP BY COALESCE(ins.sector_name_zh, '未分类')
), ranked AS (
    SELECT industry_name, total_balance,
           SUM(total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY total_balance DESC, industry_name) AS cumulative_balance,
           SUM(total_balance) OVER () AS grand_total
    FROM industry_balance
)
SELECT industry_name,
       ROUND(total_balance, 2) AS total_balance,
       ROUND(cumulative_balance * 1.0 / grand_total, 4) AS cumulative_ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE cumulative_balance * 1.0 / grand_total <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS open_loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE ld.status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'SETTLED', 'WRITTEN_OFF')
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY open_loan_count DESC, p.party_id, i.institution_id;

SELECT sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount, ca.collateral_id, cv.valuation_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
JOIN (
    SELECT collateral_id, valuation_amount
    FROM collateral_valuation cv1
    WHERE valued_on = (
        SELECT MAX(valued_on) FROM collateral_valuation cv2
        WHERE cv2.collateral_id = cv1.collateral_id
    )
) cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.valuation_amount > 2 * sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY (cv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC, sa.security_id, ca.collateral_id;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS institution_count
FROM party p
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND a.institution_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 2
ORDER BY institution_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT from_account_id AS account_id, business_date, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM payment_event
WHERE from_account_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY from_account_id, business_date
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY txn_count DESC, from_account_id, business_date
LIMIT 20;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance
FROM institution i
JOIN exposure_group eg ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id AND ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal_balance DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name, COUNT(DISTINCT gc.security_id) AS security_count,
       ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gc.security_id) > 1
   AND SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = '受托支付'
  AND ld.status = '有效'
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lbs.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_since IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(lbs.overdue_since) AS INTEGER) >= 90
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT ld.loan_id,
       borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
       ROUND(pi.instruction_amount, 2) AS instruction_amount,
       payee.display_name AS payee_name
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON borrower.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN party payee ON payee.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
WHERE pi.payment_mode = '受托支付'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE p.status = 'FROZEN'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT ld.loan_id, lpc.product_name_zh, ca.target_industry_code, ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON lpc.product_family = ca.product_family
JOIN industry_sector isec ON isec.sector_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE lpc.is_working_capital = 1
  AND isec.risk_category = '退出类'
  AND ld.status = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       lb.loan_id,
       lb.principal_balance,
       avg_bal.avg_balance,
       ROUND(lb.principal_balance - avg_bal.avg_balance, 2) AS excess
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lb.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca2.institution_id, AVG(lb2.principal_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb2
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON ld2.loan_id = lb2.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON ca2.agreement_id = ld2.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca2.institution_id
) avg_bal ON avg_bal.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE lb.principal_balance > avg_bal.avg_balance * 2
ORDER BY excess DESC, lb.loan_id;

WITH non_related AS (
    SELECT ca.institution_id,
           SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS non_related_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM party_relation pr
        WHERE pr.source_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
          AND pr.relation_type <> '非关联方'
    )
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
total AS (
    SELECT ca.institution_id,
           SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(COALESCE(nr.non_related_amount, 0), 2) AS non_related_amount,
       ROUND(t.total_amount, 2) AS total_amount,
       ROUND(COALESCE(nr.non_related_amount, 0) * 1.0 / t.total_amount, 4) AS ratio
FROM total t
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = t.institution_id
LEFT JOIN non_related nr ON nr.institution_id = t.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

WITH loan_bal AS (
    SELECT ld.agreement_id,
           ca.borrower_party_id,
           ca.institution_id,
           SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.institution_id
),
borrower_inst AS (
    SELECT institution_id,
           borrower_party_id,
           SUM(total_principal) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_bal
    GROUP BY institution_id, borrower_party_id
),
cap AS (
    SELECT institution_id,
           as_of_date,
           net_capital,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id ORDER BY as_of_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM capital_snapshot
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       p.display_name AS customer_name,
       ROUND(bi.total_principal, 2) AS total_balance,
       ROUND(c.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
       ROUND(bi.total_principal * 100.0 / c.net_capital, 2) AS concentration_pct
FROM borrower_inst bi
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = bi.institution_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = bi.borrower_party_id
JOIN cap c ON c.institution_id = bi.institution_id AND c.rn = 1
WHERE bi.total_principal * 100.0 / c.net_capital > 10
ORDER BY concentration_pct DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH industry_avg AS (
    SELECT target_industry_code,
           AVG(annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement
    WHERE target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
      AND annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY target_industry_code
)
SELECT ca.agreement_id,
       p.display_name AS borrower_name,
       ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate, 2) AS annual_interest_rate,
       ROUND(ia.avg_rate, 2) AS industry_avg_rate,
       ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 100.0 / ia.avg_rate, 2) AS premium_pct
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN industry_avg ia ON ia.target_industry_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND ia.avg_rate > 0
  AND ca.annual_interest_rate > ia.avg_rate * 1.1
ORDER BY premium_pct DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH latest_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT lbs.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN (
        SELECT loan_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS max_date
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot
        GROUP BY loan_id
    ) t ON t.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND t.max_date = lbs.as_of_date
),
latest_capital AS (
    SELECT cs.institution_id, cs.net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    JOIN (
        SELECT institution_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS max_date
        FROM capital_snapshot
        GROUP BY institution_id
    ) t ON t.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND t.max_date = cs.as_of_date
),
borrower_exposure AS (
    SELECT ca.institution_id,
           ca.borrower_party_id,
           SUM(llb.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN latest_loan_balance llb ON llb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS over_limit_customer_count
FROM borrower_exposure be
JOIN latest_capital lc ON lc.institution_id = be.institution_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = be.institution_id
WHERE be.total_principal > 0.10 * lc.net_capital
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY over_limit_customer_count DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH group_loan AS (
    SELECT eg.exposure_group_id,
           eg.group_name,
           eg.institution_id,
           SUM(lb.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
                            AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
),
cap AS (
    SELECT cs.institution_id, cs.net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    JOIN (SELECT institution_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS md FROM capital_snapshot GROUP BY institution_id) m
      ON m.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND m.md = cs.as_of_date
)
SELECT g.exposure_group_id,
       g.group_name,
       ROUND(g.total_balance, 2) AS total_balance,
       ROUND(c.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
       ROUND(g.total_balance * 100.0 / c.net_capital, 2) AS pct
FROM group_loan g
JOIN cap c ON c.institution_id = g.institution_id
WHERE g.total_balance > 0.10 * c.net_capital
ORDER BY pct DESC;

SELECT ca.agreement_id,
       ca.maturity_on,
       ld.loan_id,
       ld.status,
       ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'EXPIRED'
  AND ld.status = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT ld.loan_id,
       ld.disbursement_account_id,
       ld.disbursed_on,
       pe.payment_id,
       pe.business_date,
       ROUND(pe.amount, 2) AS amount,
       CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_after_disbursement
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE ld.disbursement_account_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND julianday(pe.business_date) >= julianday(ld.disbursed_on)
  AND julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) <= 7
ORDER BY days_after_disbursement ASC, amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH latest_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT lbs.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN (
        SELECT loan_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS max_date
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot
        GROUP BY loan_id
    ) t ON t.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND t.max_date = lbs.as_of_date
),
latest_capital AS (
    SELECT cs.institution_id, cs.net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    JOIN (
        SELECT institution_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS max_date
        FROM capital_snapshot
        GROUP BY institution_id
    ) t ON t.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND t.max_date = cs.as_of_date
),
borrower_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(llb.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN latest_loan_balance llb ON llb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_name,
        p.display_name AS customer_name,
        be.total_principal * 1.0 / lc.net_capital AS ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY be.institution_id ORDER BY be.total_principal * 1.0 / lc.net_capital DESC) AS rn
    FROM borrower_exposure be
    JOIN latest_capital lc ON lc.institution_id = be.institution_id
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = be.institution_id
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = be.borrower_party_id
    WHERE lc.net_capital IS NOT NULL AND lc.net_capital <> 0
)
SELECT institution_name, customer_name, ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT lbs.loan_id,
           lbs.principal_balance,
           ld.agreement_id,
           ca.institution_id,
           NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS quartile
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
)
SELECT loan_id, principal_balance, quartile
FROM ranked
ORDER BY quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

WITH inst_total AS (
    SELECT ca.institution_id AS institution_id,
           SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT ld.loan_id,
       i.institution_name,
       lbs.principal_balance,
       ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 100.0 / it.total_principal, 2) AS pct
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN inst_total it ON it.institution_id = ca.institution_id
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC, pct DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT l.loan_id,
       ROUND(l.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
       l.status,
       ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS overdue_principal_total,
       COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = l.loan_id
WHERE l.status = 'NORMAL'
  AND rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.disbursed_amount, l.status
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC, overdue_principal_total DESC, l.loan_id ASC;

SELECT loan_account_id, disbursed_on, COUNT(*) AS loan_cnt
FROM loan_drawdown
GROUP BY loan_account_id, disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY loan_cnt DESC, loan_account_id, disbursed_on
LIMIT 200;

SELECT p.party_id
FROM party p
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = ah.account_id
INTERSECT
SELECT p.party_id
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY party_id;

SELECT sm.person_party_id
FROM staff_member sm
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account_holder ah
    WHERE ah.party_id = sm.person_party_id
  )
ORDER BY sm.person_party_id;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM payment_event pe
    WHERE pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
      AND pe.is_cash = 1
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT security_id, guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment
WHERE status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY guaranteed_amount DESC, security_id;

SELECT CASE
           WHEN julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') < 0 THEN '已到期'
           WHEN julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 90 THEN '临期'
           ELSE '常态'
       END AS maturity_bucket,
       COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
GROUP BY maturity_bucket
ORDER BY CASE maturity_bucket
             WHEN '常态' THEN 1
             WHEN '临期' THEN 2
             WHEN '已到期' THEN 3
         END;

SELECT cl.collateral_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS link_count
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) > 1
ORDER BY link_count DESC, cl.collateral_id;

SELECT ca.collateral_type,
       ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS avg_valuation_amount,
       COUNT(*) AS valuation_count
FROM collateral_valuation cv
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY avg_valuation_amount DESC;

WITH loan_repay AS (
    SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.repayment_account_id, ld.disbursed_on, ld.disbursed_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
),
acct_counts AS (
    SELECT repayment_account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS loan_cnt
    FROM loan_repay
    GROUP BY repayment_account_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) >= 3
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT lr.repayment_account_id, lr.loan_id, lr.disbursed_on, lr.disbursed_amount,
           ac.loan_cnt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lr.repayment_account_id ORDER BY lr.disbursed_on ASC, lr.loan_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM loan_repay lr
    JOIN acct_counts ac ON ac.repayment_account_id = lr.repayment_account_id
)
SELECT repayment_account_id, loan_id, disbursed_on,
       ROUND(disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
       loan_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY repayment_account_id ASC, disbursed_on ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ca.agreement_id,
       ca.contract_amount,
       SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed,
       SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount AS excess_amount,
       COUNT(*) AS drawdown_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT abs.account_id) AS 账户数量,
       ROUND(SUM(abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance), 2) AS 差额合计
FROM account_balance_snapshot abs
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE abs.available_balance IS NOT NULL
  AND abs.ledger_balance > abs.available_balance
  AND (abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 差额合计 DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT td.account_id, td.opening_principal, td.maturity_on, td.annual_interest_rate
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on, td.account_id;

SELECT card_id, card_type, issued_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'DEBIT'
  AND issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY issued_on, card_id;

SELECT
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 累计受托支付金额,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 累计自主支付金额,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 4) AS 受托支付占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) < 0.52
ORDER BY 受托支付占比 ASC, 机构名称 ASC;

SELECT d.agreement_id,
       d.loan_id,
       ROUND(d.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(d.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.agreement_id), 2) AS total_disbursed,
       ROUND(d.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / SUM(d.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.agreement_id), 2) AS pct
FROM loan_drawdown d
WHERE d.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / SUM(d.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.agreement_id) > 0.9
ORDER BY d.agreement_id;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS 实际募集合计,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 计划募集合计,
       ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS 完成率
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) > 1.2
ORDER BY 完成率 DESC;

WITH loan_status AS (
    SELECT ld.loan_id,
           ca.borrower_party_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_overdue
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    LEFT JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT p.party_id AS borrower_party_id,
       p.display_name AS borrower_name,
       SUM(ls.has_overdue) AS overdue_loan_count,
       COUNT(*) AS total_loan_count
FROM loan_status ls
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ls.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(ls.has_overdue) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN ls.has_overdue = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT pi.instruction_id,
       pi.loan_id,
       borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
       payee.display_name AS payee_name,
       ROUND(pi.instruction_amount, 2) AS instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON borrower.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN party payee ON payee.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id <> ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_on, ca.agreement_id, ca.signed_on, ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount,2) AS disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ca.signed_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id;

SELECT rs.loan_id AS 借据编号,
       COUNT(*) AS 未结清期次数,
       ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 应还本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'SETTLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
ORDER BY 应还本金合计 DESC, rs.loan_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ld.loan_id,
       ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
       ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_on, ld.disbursement_account_id, a.opened_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.disbursement_account_id, a.account_kind,
       ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, ca.security_type, ROUND(ca.contract_amount,2) AS contract_amount, p.display_name
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE ca.security_type = 'CREDIT' AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH related_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT source_party_id AS party_id
    FROM party_relation
    WHERE relation_type <> '非关联方'
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT target_party_id AS party_id
    FROM party_relation
    WHERE relation_type <> '非关联方'
),
avg_rate AS (
    SELECT ca.institution_id, ca.product_family,
           AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.product_family
)
SELECT p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
       ca.borrower_party_id AS 客户编号,
       ca.annual_interest_rate AS 合同年利率,
       ROUND(ar.avg_rate, 4) AS 同机构同类产品平均年利率,
       ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate - ar.avg_rate, 4) AS 利率价差
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN related_borrowers rb ON rb.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN avg_rate ar ON ar.institution_id = ca.institution_id
                AND ar.product_family = ca.product_family
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.annual_interest_rate < ar.avg_rate
ORDER BY 利率价差 DESC, ca.borrower_party_id;

SELECT pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id, rt.relation_name_zh
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rt ON rt.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE pr.relation_type <> '非关联方'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM credit_agreement ca
      WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM credit_agreement ca
      WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
  )
ORDER BY rt.relation_name_zh, pr.relation_id;

SELECT
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 成员数,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 余额合计,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS 资本净额,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS 占比
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs
    ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date)
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
  AND cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(cs2.as_of_date)
        FROM capital_snapshot cs2
        WHERE cs2.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    )
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 2
   AND SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.1
ORDER BY 占比 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT payer.display_name AS 付款方姓名,
       payee.display_name AS 收款方姓名,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pe.payment_id) AS 转账笔数,
       ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 转账金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON ah_from.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON ah_to.account_id = pe.to_account_id
JOIN party payer ON payer.party_id = ah_from.party_id
JOIN party payee ON payee.party_id = ah_to.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = payer.party_id
                      AND pr.target_party_id = payee.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方'
GROUP BY payer.party_id, payer.display_name, payee.party_id, payee.display_name
ORDER BY 转账金额合计 DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT wp.product_id, wp.product_name, ma.asset_name
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND phs.investment_path = 'MULTI_LAYER'
ORDER BY wp.product_id;

SELECT phs.product_id,
       COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
WHERE phs.investment_path = 'MULTI_LAYER_INTERMEDIARY'
GROUP BY phs.product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT lbs.loan_id,
       lbs.principal_balance,
       MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS max_overdue_days
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > 90000000
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY lbs.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance
HAVING MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY max_overdue_days DESC, lbs.loan_id ASC;

SELECT eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
       eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS 涉及机构数,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 取得授信的成员数
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 涉及机构数 DESC, eg.exposure_group_id;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 逾期成员数,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, eg.exposure_group_id;

WITH loan_borrower AS (
    SELECT borrower_party_id AS party_id, SUM(contract_amount) AS loan_total
    FROM credit_agreement
    GROUP BY borrower_party_id
),
guarantor AS (
    SELECT guarantor_party_id AS party_id, SUM(guaranteed_amount) AS guarantee_total
    FROM guarantor_commitment
    GROUP BY guarantor_party_id
)
SELECT p.display_name, p.party_id,
       ROUND(g.guarantee_total, 2) AS guarantee_total,
       ROUND(l.loan_total, 2) AS loan_total,
       ROUND(g.guarantee_total - l.loan_total, 2) AS net_guarantee
FROM party p
JOIN loan_borrower l ON l.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN guarantor g ON g.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
  AND g.guarantee_total > l.loan_total
ORDER BY net_guarantee DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT p.display_name AS staff_name, sm.staff_id, COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS agreement_count
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sm.staff_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY agreement_count DESC, sm.staff_id;

SELECT p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
       p.party_id AS 客户编号,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
       pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 倍数
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 2
ORDER BY 倍数 DESC, p.party_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT p.display_name AS staff_name,
       so.operator_id,
       so.authority_level,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS self_loan_agreement_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE so.operator_kind = 'CREDIT_OFFICER'
GROUP BY so.operator_id, p.display_name, so.authority_level
ORDER BY self_loan_agreement_count DESC;

SELECT p.display_name AS staff_name,
       ld.loan_id,
       ld.disbursed_amount,
       ld.disbursed_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.person_party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE ah.holder_role = 'HOLDER'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

WITH borrower_repayment AS (
    SELECT ld.agreement_id,
           ca.borrower_party_id,
           SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) AS total_due
    FROM repayment_schedule rs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
borrower_total AS (
    SELECT borrower_party_id, SUM(total_due) AS total_due
    FROM borrower_repayment
    GROUP BY borrower_party_id
)
SELECT p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
       p.party_id AS 客户编号,
       ROUND(pp.annual_income, 2) AS 个人年收入,
       ROUND(bt.total_due, 2) AS 应还本息总额,
       ROUND(bt.total_due * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 占年收入倍数
FROM borrower_total bt
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = bt.borrower_party_id
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = bt.borrower_party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
ORDER BY 占年收入倍数 DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT lp.product_name_zh AS 产品类别名称,
       COUNT(*) AS 逾期期数,
       ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lp ON lp.product_code = ca.product_family
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY lp.product_code, lp.product_name_zh
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, lp.product_name_zh;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_cnt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_90_cnt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_90_cnt
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY expired_cnt DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id,
       ou.unit_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM account a
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY a.account_id, ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ah.party_id) > 1
ORDER BY joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name, COUNT(*) AS overdue_count, ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = ca.managing_org_unit_id
WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT rs.loan_id AS 贷款编号,
       COUNT(*) AS 逾期期数,
       ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING SUM(rs.principal_due) > 120000000
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, rs.loan_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS overdue_count,
       ROUND(SUM(rs.interest_due), 2) AS total_interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT loan_id, installment_no, principal_due, interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule
WHERE status = 'OVERDUE' AND paid_on IS NULL AND principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY principal_due DESC, loan_id, installment_no;

WITH facility_amt AS (
  SELECT institution_id, SUM(limit_amount) AS total_limit
  FROM credit_facility
  GROUP BY institution_id
),
loan_amt AS (
  SELECT ca.institution_id, SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
  FROM loan_drawdown ld
  JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
  GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
capital AS (
  SELECT institution_id, net_capital
  FROM capital_snapshot
  WHERE (institution_id, as_of_date) IN (
    SELECT institution_id, MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot GROUP BY institution_id
  )
)
SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       ROUND(COALESCE(f.total_limit, 0), 2) AS 授信额度合计,
       ROUND(COALESCE(l.total_disbursed, 0), 2) AS 发放金额合计,
       ROUND(c.net_capital, 2) AS 资本净额,
       ROUND(COALESCE(l.total_disbursed, 0) * 1.0 / c.net_capital, 4) AS 发放对资本净额占比
FROM institution i
JOIN capital c ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN facility_amt f ON f.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_amt l ON l.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE COALESCE(l.total_disbursed, 0) > c.net_capital
ORDER BY 发放对资本净额占比 DESC;

SELECT sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
       sa.secured_amount AS 设定担保金额,
       COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS 保证人个数,
       ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 保证金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
  AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 保证金额合计 DESC, sa.security_id;

SELECT cf.facility_id, cf.limit_amount, sc.name_zh
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN status_catalog sc ON sc.entity = 'CREDIT_AGREEMENT' AND sc.status_code = cf.status
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
ORDER BY cf.limit_amount DESC, cf.facility_id;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       cf.facility_type AS 授信类型代码,
       ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 授信限额合计
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cf.facility_type
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY 授信限额合计 DESC;

SELECT facility_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM credit_facility
WHERE limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY facility_type
ORDER BY record_count DESC, facility_type;

SELECT pmc.payment_mode_name_zh, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS record_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pmc.payment_mode = ld.payment_mode
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY record_count DESC, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           minimum_holding_days,
           NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS grp
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE'
)
SELECT grp,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
GROUP BY grp
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY grp;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 循环授信限额合计,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 发放笔数
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = '循环授信'
  AND ld.payment_mode = '受托支付'
ORDER BY 循环授信限额合计 DESC;

SELECT pmc.payment_mode_name_zh AS 支付方式中文名称, COUNT(*) AS 待执行指令数量
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pmc.payment_mode = pi.payment_mode
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 待执行指令数量 DESC, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh;

SELECT itc.name_zh AS instrument_type_name, sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM instrument_type_catalog itc
CROSS JOIN status_catalog sc
WHERE sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY itc.name_zh, sc.name_zh;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sa.staff_id) AS manager_count
FROM staff_assignment sa
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = sa.org_unit_id
WHERE sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_MANAGER'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY manager_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT ds.loan_id, cg.grade_name_zh, ds.principal_overdue_days, ROUND(ds.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ds.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = ds.as_of_date
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 30
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 0
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC, ds.loan_id

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS 覆盖不足借据笔数
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ps.provision_stage = '2'
  AND ps.required_amount > 0
  AND ps.recognized_amount * 1.0 / ps.required_amount < 0.5
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY 覆盖不足借据笔数 DESC, i.institution_name ASC

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS 拨备缺口合计
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY 拨备缺口合计 DESC, i.institution_name ASC

SELECT a.account_id, a.account_subtype, abs.balance
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot abs ON abs.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.status = 'DORMANT'
  AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM account_holder ah
      WHERE ah.account_id = a.account_id
        AND ah.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
  )
ORDER BY abs.balance DESC;

SELECT p.customer_segment,
       COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM person_profile pp
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT ma.asset_category_primary,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM managed_asset ma
WHERE ma.asset_scope = 'TRUSTED'
  AND ma.industry_code IN (
      SELECT sector_code FROM industry_sector WHERE risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
  )
GROUP BY ma.asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY cnt DESC, ma.asset_category_primary;

WITH personal_credit AS (
    SELECT cf.obligor_party_id AS party_id,
           SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_limit
    FROM credit_facility cf
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = cf.obligor_party_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
    GROUP BY cf.obligor_party_id
)
SELECT pc.party_id AS 客户编号,
       pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
       ROUND(pc.total_limit, 2) AS 授信额度合计,
       ROUND(pc.total_limit * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 偿债比
FROM personal_credit pc
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = pc.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
  AND pc.total_limit * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY 偿债比 DESC, pc.party_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT occupation_code, employment_sector, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM person_profile
GROUP BY occupation_code, employment_sector
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, occupation_code ASC, employment_sector ASC;

SELECT pc.status AS card_status, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON ctc.card_type = pc.card_type
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '借记卡'
GROUP BY pc.status
ORDER BY card_count DESC, pc.status;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
       ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
       COUNT(*) AS 交易笔数,
       ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pc.holder_party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = p.home_org_unit_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 金额合计 DESC, ou.unit_name ASC;

SELECT pe.payment_id,
       pc.card_id,
       pc.holder_party_id,
       pe.business_date,
       ROUND(pe.amount, 2) AS amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT pc.holder_party_id,
       COUNT(*) AS cash_txn_count,
       ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS cash_txn_amount
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY cash_txn_count DESC, cash_txn_amount DESC;

SELECT pc.holder_party_id AS party_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card pc
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY card_count DESC, pc.holder_party_id ASC;

SELECT ctc.name_zh AS card_type_name,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
       ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON ctc.card_type = pc.card_type
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pc.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')
GROUP BY pc.card_type, ctc.name_zh
ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, card_type_name ASC;

SELECT channel,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt,
       AVG(amount) AS avg_amt
FROM payment_event
WHERE status = 'SETTLED'
  AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY channel
HAVING AVG(amount) > 11780000
ORDER BY avg_amt DESC, channel;

SELECT td.account_id, td.maturity_on, a.status
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on DESC, td.account_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, MAX(cv.valuation_amount) AS max_valuation
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY max_valuation DESC, ca.collateral_id;

select ca.collateral_id,
       ca.asset_label,
       count(*) as 引用次数,
       count(distinct cl.security_id) as 关联担保合同数
from collateral_link cl
join collateral_asset ca on ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
where cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
group by ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
having count(*) >= 2
order by 引用次数 desc, ca.collateral_id

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT agreement_id, SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY agreement_id
)
SELECT
    p.party_id AS 保证人客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS 保证承诺金额,
    ROUND(lt.total_disbursed, 2) AS 实际放款总金额
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN loan_totals lt ON lt.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.guaranteed_amount > lt.total_disbursed
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, p.party_id ASC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH valid_agreement AS (
    SELECT agreement_id, borrower_party_id, contract_amount
    FROM credit_agreement
    WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
),
valid_security AS (
    SELECT security_id
    FROM security_agreement
    WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
),
coverage AS (
    SELECT so.agreement_id, SUM(so.covered_amount) AS total_covered
    FROM secured_obligation so
    JOIN valid_security vs ON vs.security_id = so.security_id
    WHERE so.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY so.agreement_id
)
SELECT va.agreement_id,
       va.borrower_party_id,
       va.contract_amount,
       COALESCE(c.total_covered, 0) AS 担保覆盖合计,
       ROUND(va.contract_amount - COALESCE(c.total_covered, 0), 2) AS 保障缺口
FROM valid_agreement va
LEFT JOIN coverage c ON c.agreement_id = va.agreement_id
WHERE va.contract_amount > COALESCE(c.total_covered, 0)
ORDER BY 保障缺口 DESC, va.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       cg.grade_name_zh,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ps.loan_id) AS 拨备不足借据笔数
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 拨备不足借据笔数 DESC, i.institution_name ASC

WITH latest_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT loan_id, principal_balance,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY loan_id ORDER BY as_of_date DESC, loan_balance_id DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot
)
SELECT
    ca.borrower_party_id AS 债务人编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    llb.principal_balance AS 贷款余额,
    ca.contract_amount AS 授信金额,
    ROUND(llb.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 余额倍数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN latest_loan_balance llb ON llb.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND llb.rn = 1
WHERE llb.principal_balance >= ca.contract_amount * 4
ORDER BY 余额倍数 DESC, ld.loan_id ASC

WITH latest_provision AS (
    SELECT loan_id, grade_code, required_amount, recognized_amount,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY loan_id ORDER BY as_of_date DESC, provision_id DESC) AS rn
    FROM provision_snapshot
),
latest_classification AS (
    SELECT loan_id, grade_code,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY loan_id ORDER BY as_of_date DESC, classification_id DESC) AS rn
    FROM risk_classification
),
over_provision AS (
    SELECT lp.loan_id, lc.grade_code,
           lp.recognized_amount - lp.required_amount AS over_amount
    FROM latest_provision lp
    JOIN latest_classification lc ON lc.loan_id = lp.loan_id AND lc.rn = 1
    JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = lc.grade_code
    WHERE lp.rn = 1
      AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
      AND lp.recognized_amount > lp.required_amount
)
SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       cg.grade_name_zh AS 五级分类名称,
       COUNT(*) AS 多计提笔数,
       ROUND(SUM(op.over_amount), 2) AS 多计提金额合计
FROM over_provision op
JOIN latest_classification lc ON lc.loan_id = op.loan_id AND lc.rn = 1
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = lc.grade_code
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = op.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 多计提金额合计 DESC, 机构名称 ASC, 五级分类名称 ASC

SELECT ca.collateral_id,
       ca.asset_label,
       ROUND(internal_max.max_amount, 2) AS internal_max_value,
       ROUND(external_max.max_amount, 2) AS external_max_value,
       ROUND(internal_max.max_amount - external_max.max_amount, 2) AS undervaluation_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN (
    SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_amount
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
) internal_max ON internal_max.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN (
    SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_amount
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
) external_max ON external_max.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE external_max.max_amount < internal_max.max_amount
ORDER BY internal_max.max_amount - external_max.max_amount DESC, ca.collateral_id;

SELECT ca.collateral_id,
       ca.asset_label,
       ROUND(latest.valuation_amount, 2) AS latest_valuation,
       ROUND(pledge.total_pledged, 2) AS total_pledged,
       ROUND(pledge.total_pledged - latest.valuation_amount, 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN (
    SELECT cl.collateral_id, SUM(cl.pledged_amount) AS total_pledged
    FROM collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
) pledge ON pledge.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN (
    SELECT cv.collateral_id, cv.valuation_amount
    FROM collateral_valuation cv
    JOIN (
        SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valued_on) AS max_valued_on
        FROM collateral_valuation
        GROUP BY collateral_id
    ) m ON m.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id AND m.max_valued_on = cv.valued_on
) latest ON latest.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE latest.valuation_amount < pledge.total_pledged
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC;

SELECT p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
       p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
       ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 自身借款金额合计,
       ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 对外保证金额合计
FROM party p
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount) > SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount)
ORDER BY 对外保证金额合计 DESC;

SELECT sa.security_id,
       ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS secured_amount,
       COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
       ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) DESC, sa.security_id;

SELECT p.customer_segment,
       COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE pp.is_public_official = 1
  AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       egtc.name_zh AS 敞口组类型名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 成员去重数量
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_type_catalog egtc ON egtc.group_type = eg.group_type
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name, egtc.name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY 成员去重数量 DESC;

SELECT p.party_id AS 成员客户编号,
       p.display_name AS 客户名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT p.party_id AS 主体编号,
       p.display_name AS 主体名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
