WHERE pr.relation_type <> '非关联方'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联关系条数 DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT p.party_id,
       p.display_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr
  ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
  OR pr.target_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
  ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type = 'SHADOW_SHAREHOLDER'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY group_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    pr.relation_id AS 关系编号,
    pr.source_party_id AS 关系一方主体编号,
    pr.target_party_id AS 关系另一方主体编号,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_src.agreement_id) AS 一主体现有借款合同数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_tgt.agreement_id) AS 另一主体现有借款合同数
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN credit_agreement ca_src
    ON ca_src.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
   AND ca_src.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN credit_agreement ca_tgt
    ON ca_tgt.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
   AND ca_tgt.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT ca_src.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca_tgt.agreement_id)) DESC, pr.relation_id;

select ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, ca.collateral_type
from collateral_asset ca
where ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  and not exists (
    select 1 from collateral_link cl
    where cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id and cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
order by ca.collateral_id

WITH active_guarantees AS (
    SELECT gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
           SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND (gc.effective_to IS NULL OR gc.effective_to >= date('now'))
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
loan_exposure AS (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
           SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date)
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
       p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
       ROUND(ag.total_guaranteed, 2) AS 有效保证责任合计,
       ROUND(COALESCE(le.total_principal, 0), 2) AS 自身贷款金额,
       ROUND(ag.total_guaranteed - COALESCE(le.total_principal, 0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM active_guarantees ag
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ag.party_id
LEFT JOIN loan_exposure le ON le.party_id = ag.party_id
WHERE ag.total_guaranteed > COALESCE(le.total_principal, 0)
ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS 保证金额,
    gc.status AS 保证状态
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM loan_drawdown ld
      JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
      JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
      WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
        AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
  )
ORDER BY 保证金额 DESC, 保证人编号 ASC;

WITH RECURSIVE holding_chain AS (
    -- 直接持有
    SELECT phs.product_id,
           phs.asset_id,
           phs.investment_path,
           phs.lookthrough_depth,
           phs.intermediary_party_id,
           phs.asset_id AS root_asset_id
    FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
    UNION ALL
    -- 通过中间产品嵌套持有
    SELECT hc.product_id,
           phs.asset_id,
           phs.investment_path,
           phs.lookthrough_depth,
           phs.intermediary_party_id,
           phs.asset_id AS root_asset_id
    FROM holding_chain hc
    JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = hc.asset_id
    JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM holding_chain hc
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = hc.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = hc.root_asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = ma.obligor_party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ma.obligor_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY wp.product_name ASC, overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT sa.security_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT sa.security_id) AS security_count,
       ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS total_covered_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
WHERE sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY SUM(so.covered_amount) DESC, sa.security_type;

SELECT ca.agreement_id,
       p.display_name AS borrower_name,
       ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
       ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM institution i
JOIN exposure_group eg ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
                         AND ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE eg.group_type = 'CUSTOMER'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY SUM(ca.contract_amount) DESC, i.institution_id;

SELECT wp.product_id,
       wp.product_name,
       ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value), 2) AS inversion_amount,
       COUNT(*) AS inversion_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE phs.fair_value IS NOT NULL
  AND phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY inversion_amount DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT wp.product_name,
       ma.asset_name,
       phs.lookthrough_depth,
       phs.carrying_amount,
       ROUND(od.overdue_principal_sum, 2) AS overdue_principal_sum
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ld.agreement_id,
           ca.borrower_party_id,
           ca.institution_id,
           SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) AS overdue_principal_sum
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.institution_id
) od ON od.borrower_party_id = ma.issuer_party_id
     AND od.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
ORDER BY phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_priority_valid_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_60_count
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.lien_priority = 1
  AND cl.status = '有效'
  AND (cl.effective_to IS NULL OR cl.effective_to >= date('now'))
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY over_60_count DESC, cl.collateral_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       fs.total_assets,
       fs.total_liabilities,
       fs.net_assets,
       fs.annual_revenue
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY fs.annual_revenue DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_id,
       ROUND(fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 4) AS debt_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.total_assets IS NOT NULL AND fs.total_assets <> 0
ORDER BY debt_ratio DESC, i.institution_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS tier1_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
ORDER BY tier1_ratio DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name AS institution_name,
       ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS capital_asset_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.total_assets IS NOT NULL AND fs.total_assets <> 0
ORDER BY capital_asset_ratio DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(SUM(fs.annual_revenue), 2) AS 营业收入,
       ROUND(SUM(fs.annual_revenue) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(fs2.annual_revenue)
                                                FROM financial_snapshot fs2
                                                JOIN institution i2 ON fs2.party_id = 'PTY-' || i2.institution_id), 2) AS 占比
FROM financial_snapshot fs
JOIN institution i ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(fs.annual_revenue) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(fs2.annual_revenue)
                                          FROM financial_snapshot fs2
                                          JOIN institution i2 ON fs2.party_id = 'PTY-' || i2.institution_id) > 15
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.internal_rating <> ma.external_rating
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY cnt DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT ma.valuation_method,
       ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
GROUP BY ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC, ma.valuation_method;

SELECT i.institution_name AS institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS deposit_count,
       ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY cnt DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT so.authority_level,
       COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = 'FIXED'
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') BETWEEN 0 AND 30
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH under_provision AS (
    SELECT ld.agreement_id,
           SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) AS shortfall
    FROM provision_snapshot ps
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
    WHERE ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
),
inst_shortfall AS (
    SELECT ca.institution_id,
           SUM(up.shortfall) AS total_shortfall
    FROM under_provision up
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = up.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
inst_net_assets AS (
    SELECT i.institution_id,
           fs.net_assets
    FROM institution i
    JOIN financial_snapshot fs
      ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
     AND fs.as_of_date = (
         SELECT MAX(fs2.as_of_date)
         FROM financial_snapshot fs2
         WHERE fs2.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
     )
)
SELECT i.institution_id,
       i.institution_name,
       ROUND(s.total_shortfall, 2) AS total_shortfall,
       ROUND(na.net_assets, 2) AS net_assets,
       ROUND(s.total_shortfall * 100.0 / na.net_assets, 2) AS shortfall_pct
FROM inst_shortfall s
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = s.institution_id
JOIN inst_net_assets na ON na.institution_id = s.institution_id
WHERE s.total_shortfall > 0
  AND na.net_assets IS NOT NULL
  AND na.net_assets <> 0
ORDER BY shortfall_pct DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT cg.grade_name_zh AS 风险分类名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rc.loan_id) AS 借据数量
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE rc.classification_basis = 'MANUAL'
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rc.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 借据数量 DESC, 风险分类名称 ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ds.loan_id) AS 不良借据笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
GROUP BY i.institution_id
HAVING SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / MAX(fs.annual_revenue) > 0.5
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

WITH loan_principal AS (
    SELECT ca.institution_id AS institution_id,
           SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.closed_on IS NULL
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
latest_capital AS (
    SELECT cs.institution_id AS institution_id,
           cs.risk_weighted_assets AS rwa
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    JOIN (
        SELECT institution_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS max_date
        FROM capital_snapshot
        GROUP BY institution_id
    ) t ON t.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND t.max_date = cs.as_of_date
)
SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       ROUND(lp.total_principal, 2) AS 本金余额合计,
       ROUND(lc.rwa, 2) AS 风险加权资产,
       ROUND(lp.total_principal * 100.0 / lc.rwa, 2) AS 贷款占风险加权资产百分比
FROM loan_principal lp
JOIN latest_capital lc ON lc.institution_id = lp.institution_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = lp.institution_id
ORDER BY 贷款占风险加权资产百分比 DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT pi.payment_mode,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY cnt DESC, pi.payment_mode;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS exception_count,
       ROUND(SUM(p.amount_value), 2) AS exception_amount,
       fs.net_assets AS net_capital,
       fs.total_assets AS total_assets,
       ROUND(SUM(p.amount_value) * 100.0 / fs.net_assets, 4) AS pct_of_net_capital
FROM prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 p
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = p.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || p.institution_id
WHERE p.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY p.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets, fs.total_assets
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8
ORDER BY pct_of_net_capital DESC;

WITH overdue_sub AS (
    SELECT institution_id,
           COUNT(*) AS overdue_cnt,
           AVG(amount_value) AS avg_amount
    FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3
    WHERE completion_date IS NULL OR completion_date > deadline_date
    GROUP BY institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 25
),
underprovision AS (
    SELECT ld.loan_id,
           ca.institution_id,
           (ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) AS gap
    FROM provision_snapshot ps
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       os.overdue_cnt,
       ROUND(os.avg_amount, 2) AS avg_amount,
       COUNT(up.loan_id) AS underprovision_loan_cnt,
       ROUND(SUM(up.gap), 2) AS total_gap
FROM overdue_sub os
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = os.institution_id
LEFT JOIN underprovision up ON up.institution_id = os.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, os.overdue_cnt, os.avg_amount
ORDER BY total_gap DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS facility_count,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN g.exception_flag = 1 THEN g.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS except_amount,
       ROUND(AVG(g.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN governance_control_record_v3 g ON g.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN g.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
ORDER BY except_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT p.display_name AS customer_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS target_party_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS relation_type_cnt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN rt.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_unrelated_cnt
FROM related_transaction_record_v3 r
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = r.subject_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = r.subject_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rt ON rt.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE r.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY target_party_cnt DESC, relation_type_cnt DESC, customer_name ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS 有效发卡张数,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS 持卡客户数,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.exception_flag = 1 THEN o.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 操作风险异常金额,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.record_id) AS 操作风险有效记录数
FROM institution i
JOIN account a ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN operational_risk_event_v3 o ON o.institution_id = i.institution_id AND o.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.record_id) >= 43
ORDER BY 操作风险异常金额 DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.product_id END) AS on_sale_products,
       ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_raise,
       COUNT(*) AS conduct_records,
       ROUND(AVG(pce.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM product_conduct_event_v3 pce
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = pce.institution_id
LEFT JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE pce.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY total_raise DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS 底层资产数,
       ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT ma.issued_amount), 2) AS 发行金额合计,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN co.status_code = 'ACTIVE' THEN co.record_id END) AS 托管有效记录数,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN co.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND co.exception_flag = 1 THEN co.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 异常金额合计
FROM institution i
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN custody_operation_event_v3 co ON co.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN co.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND co.exception_flag = 1 THEN co.record_id END) >= 2
ORDER BY 发行金额合计 DESC, i.institution_name;
